summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its asset purchase from Jabanero Inc. for the Heyviva athletic wear brand. The all-cash consideration is $33,000,000, paid in four tranches tied to transfer milestones: $16.5M upfront, then $4.95M upon domain transfer, $4.95M upon U.S. trademark recordal, and $6.6M upon completion of remaining asset transfers. The deal closed on August 5, 2026, and includes a seven-year right of first refusal on EU/UK trademarks. No advisors or premium are disclosed; watch synergies with social commerce and execution of asset transfer milestones.
